symptoms_observed: Pod restarted 4 times in 10 minutes, log gap of ~30s before each restart, no OOM in describe.
root_cause: Liveness probe timeout too aggressive (2s) for a cold-start path that takes ~4s.
fix_applied: Increased livenessProbe timeoutSeconds to 6 and initialDelaySeconds to 15.

symptoms_observed: Single restart, exit code 137, memory metric shows sharp spike right before kill.
root_cause: OOMKilled due to a large batch request loading an entire dataset into memory at once.
fix_applied: Added pagination to the batch endpoint; increased memory limit as a safety margin.

symptoms_observed: Pod terminated with no application error logged, restart count +1, no OOM.
root_cause: Node was drained for maintenance, pod rescheduled elsewhere as expected.
fix_applied: No fix needed - confirmed intentional external kill via node event log.

symptoms_observed: CPU pinned at limit for 20 minutes, request latency up 3x, request rate flat.
root_cause: Inefficient regex in input validation causing catastrophic backtracking on certain payloads.
fix_applied: Rewrote the regex to avoid nested quantifiers; added a request size guard.

symptoms_observed: CPU high on one pod only, other replicas normal, request rate flat overall.
root_cause: Missing CPU limit allowed one pod to consume a disproportionate share on a shared node.
fix_applied: Set explicit CPU limits and requests on the deployment.

symptoms_observed: CPU and request rate both rose proportionally over an hour.
root_cause: Legitimate traffic increase from a marketing campaign, not an application issue.
fix_applied: No fix - confirmed via request rate correlation, added autoscaling for future spikes.

symptoms_observed: Memory grew linearly over 6 hours with flat request rate, ended in OOMKilled.
root_cause: In-memory response cache with no eviction policy, grew unbounded.
fix_applied: Added LRU eviction with a max cache size.

symptoms_observed: Slow, steady memory growth starting immediately after a deploy.
root_cause: New version introduced a connection pool that was never releasing idle connections.
fix_applied: Rolled back the deploy, fixed the pool's idle-connection cleanup, redeployed.

symptoms_observed: Memory growth correlated exactly with number of large file uploads processed.
root_cause: Uploaded file buffers held in memory after processing instead of being freed.
fix_applied: Explicitly released buffers after processing completed.

symptoms_observed: "Too many connections" errors from api-service, Threads_connected near max_connections.
root_cause: Connection leak - exception path in a query wrapper skipped closing the connection.
fix_applied: Added try/finally to guarantee connection release; added a pool max-idle timeout.

symptoms_observed: Gradual connection climb over a day, no errors yet but approaching ceiling.
root_cause: Pool max size set too high relative to actual max_connections, no safety margin.
fix_applied: Reduced app pool max size and raised MySQL max_connections slightly for headroom.

symptoms_observed: One service's connection count spiked right before the shared DB exhausted its pool.
root_cause: A new reporting job opened one connection per row instead of reusing a single connection.
fix_applied: Refactored the job to use a single connection with batched queries.

symptoms_observed: Request latency up 4x, app pod CPU/memory normal, DB CPU elevated.
root_cause: Missing index on a frequently filtered column, causing full table scans.
fix_applied: Added the missing index on the filtered column.

symptoms_observed: Latency spikes correlated with a specific report generation window.
root_cause: A long-running analytical query held a lock blocking writes from other queries.
fix_applied: Moved the analytical query to a read replica.

symptoms_observed: Slow query log showed a new query pattern after a recent feature deploy.
root_cause: New feature's query joined two large tables without an index on the join column.
fix_applied: Added a composite index covering the join and filter columns.

symptoms_observed: DiskPressure condition on node, pod evicted, emptyDir volume near full.
root_cause: Application writing debug logs to emptyDir with no rotation.
fix_applied: Added log rotation and a sizeLimit on the emptyDir volume.

symptoms_observed: PVC usage climbed steadily over a week, alert fired near 90% capacity.
root_cause: Binary log retention was not configured, logs accumulated indefinitely.
fix_applied: Set binlog expiration and cleaned up existing accumulated logs.

symptoms_observed: Sudden disk fill traced to a single volume within minutes, not gradual.
root_cause: A malformed request triggered an infinite write loop to a temp file.
fix_applied: Added input validation to prevent the malformed request and a write-size cap on temp files.
